subject.title: [codex] fix(sessions): report archive cleanup in sessions cleanup

question: Should `sessions cleanup` permanently retain the PR’s three ownership modes: agent-scoped cleanup skips shared sibling archives, `--all-agents` cleans a shared directory once, and explicit `--store` performs full offline cleanup for that selected directory?
rationale: The implementation is tested and proof-positive, but this choice determines which operator invocation is authorized to delete shared archived transcripts; it is a lasting session-state policy rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve the ownership model
options.body: Accept the tested three-mode behavior and land after the required compact-check rerun confirms the exact merge result.

options.title: Narrow automatic cleanup
options.body: Require automatic agent and all-agent cleanup to avoid shared directories entirely, leaving shared-directory cleanup to explicit offline `--store` repair.

options.title: Pause for a session-maintenance policy decision
options.body: Keep the PR open while owners specify a different archive-directory ownership contract and the contributor adapts the tests.

recommendation.title: Approve the ownership model
recommendation.body: Accept the tested three-mode behavior and land after the required compact-check rerun confirms the exact merge result.
